answer_1.quote: SEConvo features include both single-LLM simulations and dual-agent interactions.
answer_1.outputs: Generated conversations for simulating chat-based social engineering attacks in scenarios like Academic Collaboration, Academic Funding, Journalism, and Recruitment.

answer_2.quote: We assess the performance of the message-level SI detector using F1 scores for binary classification and cosine similarities for SI type identification.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate the performance of representative LLMs, such as GPT-4 and Llama2, in detecting CSE in zero-shot and few-shot prompt settings.

answer_4.quote: To verify data quality, we randomly select 400 conversations for human annotation. Each conversation is annotated by 3 annotators for the presence of malicious intent (yes/no) and ambiguity (rated 1 to 3).
answer_4.guideline: Instruction: ... You will use two labels for annotation: IsMalicious and Ambiguity.
